413e6c5297ef8f58.description: About DataVolt DataVolt is a global provider of sustainable and innovative data center solutions, offering infrastructure for businesses to connect, collaborate, and grow. The company focuses on security, reliability, scalability, and sustainability to support digital transformation for its clients. DataVolt operates in Riyadh, Dubai, Mumbai, Tashkent, Kuala Lumpur, and California, with a commitment to sustainable digital futures through innovation. The Role of Events Manager The Events Manager will play a critical role in communicating DataVolt’s brand message and value proposition to the technology ecosystem across KSA, the GCC, Central Asia, and other regions. This full-time position, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, involves owning and driving DataVolt’s events calendar from planning to execution. The role also supports the broader communications program and key initiatives aimed at business growth, requiring proficiency in both English and Arabic. The immediate focus will be on delivering events within KSA, including FII and LEAP, while developing the events strategy for markets such as the US and Central Asia. The Events Manager will contribute to establishing DataVolt as a leader in sovereign, sustainable AI infrastructure, ensuring brand consistency, credibility, and quality. Key Responsibilities Manage DataVolt’s events calendar, overseeing planning and execution. Deliver a range of events in KSA, including major platforms such as FII and LEAP. Develop and mature the events strategy across key international markets, including the US and Central Asia. Support the wider communications program and business growth initiatives. Ensure brand representation is consistent, credible, and high-quality across all events. Qualifications and Experience A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Event Management, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline is preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered. At least 8 years of experience combining events, corporate communications, and marketing. Proven experience in delivering multiple concurrent corporate and industry events across the full planning and logistics lifecycle, including major regional platforms such as FII, LEAP, or GITEX. This includes: Venue management and production partner coordination. Speaker, VIP, and attendee management. Domestic and international travel and accommodation logistics. Logistics for transport, catering, permits, event staffing, and on-site operations. Budget management and reconciliation. Experience working in-house at a technology, telecommunications, energy, infrastructure, or giga-project organization, or at an agency supporting such clients. Demonstrated corporate communications experience, including writing announcements, press releases, executive speeches, talking points, and digital content. Ability to write and edit communications content, not solely coordinate it. Capability to transform technical and commercial topics into clear, compelling content for diverse audiences, including executives, government, media, and employees. Work Environment and Travel The role requires availability to work outside normal office hours during event periods. Extensive travel within KSA is required, as it remains the primary focus of the role. International travel for venue inspections, supplier meetings, rehearsals, and event delivery in markets such as the US and Central Asia is also necessary. The candidate must be comfortable working across different time zones, adapting to local working practices, and managing cross-border travel requirements. Language Proficiency Excellent written and spoken English and Arabic are required.

41d67afcc9c135e0.description: Job Title: Supply Chain Director Department: Group Supply Chain & Logistics Reports To [Group Chief Executive Officer (CEO) / Group Chief Operating Officer (COO)] Employment Type: Full-Time About the Company: The company is a diversified group of subsidiary companies operating across Saudi Arabia. We deliver comprehensive solutions across multiple sectors, supported by an extensive network of shared logistics, transportation, and warehousing assets. As we continue to scale in alignment with Vision 2030, we are transforming our supply chain operations to drive group-wide synergies, leverage advanced digital technologies, and deliver unmatched operational and customer service excellence. Role Summary / Purpose: The Supply Chain Director is a highly strategic, executive leadership role critical to consolidating and optimizing logistics operations across our entire group of subsidiary companies. This role is responsible for seamlessly integrating disparate logistics operations—spanning separate fleets, warehouses, systems, and processes—into a single, unified, and highly efficient supply chain network covering both land and sea transport modalities. The ideal candidate will drive digital and AI-enabled performance to maximize financial and operational outcomes while delivering exceptional customer service. Crucially, the Supply Chain Director must achieve these ambitious goals not through direct, day-to-day personal execution, but through robust strategic planning and the effective delegation through the line, empowering and holding accountable a comprehensive management team beneath them. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Integration & Network Optimization Develop and execute a comprehensive group-wide supply chain and logistics strategy covering all subsidiary companies. Lead the integration of disparate logistics operations (unifying separate fleets, warehouses, IT systems, vendors, and processes) into an efficient, scalable, and unified supply chain. Drive strategic planning, network design, capacity planning, and robust contingency/risk management protocols. Ensure seamless nationwide logistics coverage across all regions of Saudi Arabia (Central, Western, Eastern, Southern, and Northern), supporting major industrial zones and giga-projects in key cities including Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Makkah, and Madinah. Operations & Asset Management Directly manage transportation and warehousing assets on behalf of the group, consolidating shared logistics resources to maximize asset utilization. Oversee a multimodal logistics network encompassing both land and sea freight, covering inbound, outbound, intercompany, and last-mile movements. Negotiate and strategically manage contracts with land and sea carriers, 3PLs, warehouse providers, and other critical logistics partners. Ensure strict compliance with Saudi regulations, customs laws, transport directives, safety standards, and broader Vision 2030 alignment. Digital Transformation & AI Application Champion the digital transformation of group logistics through the implementation and optimization of ERP, TMS, WMS, telematics, IoT, and automation systems. Apply artificial intelligence (AI) and advanced analytics to maximize operational performance and financial outcomes, specifically driving initiatives in route optimization, demand forecasting, predictive maintenance, dynamic pricing, and dynamic capacity planning. Performance Management & Leadership (Delegation Through the Line) Build, lead, and mentor a robust management team, achieving operational and strategic results strictly through effective delegation through the line. Foster a culture of accountability, empowerment, and continuous improvement, allowing the management team to independently execute while adhering to group strategy. Design, implement, and govern operations through detailed performance KPIs that meticulously track both operational success factors and customer service outcomes. Establish strict governance, SOPs, and regular performance review cadences across all subsidiary logistics operations. Collaborate closely with subsidiary leadership, finance, procurement, operations, and commercial teams to drive cost optimization and working capital efficiency. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): The Supply Chain Director will manage the management team against a comprehensive framework of KPIs, including but not limited to: Operational KPIs: On-time delivery (OTD), fleet utilization rates, warehouse throughput, cost per km/ton, inventory accuracy, asset downtime, safety incidents, fuel efficiency, and order cycle time. Customer Service KPIs: Order fulfillment rate (OFR), customer satisfaction (CSAT), service level agreement (SLA) adherence, complaint resolution time, delivery accuracy, and reverse logistics/returns handling efficiency. Financial KPIs: Total logistics cost as a percentage of revenue, realized cost savings through consolidation, working capital improvement, and ROI on digital/AI system investments. Strategic KPIs: Subsidiary integration milestones achieved, digital system adoption rates, and AI-driven performance gains (e.g., measurable improvements in route efficiency or demand forecasting accuracy). Qualifications & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. An MBA or relevant Master’s degree is highly preferred. 15+ years of extensive supply chain and logistics experience, including at least 5–7 years in a senior executive leadership role managing multi-site, multi-subsidiary operations. Proven, in-depth experience navigating the logistics and regulatory landscape of Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC. Deep operational expertise in land and sea transport, large-scale warehousing, fleet management, and 3PL vendor management. Demonstrated success in integrating disparate subsidiary logistics operations into a centralized, unified supply chain network. Proven ability to achieve strategic results through "delegation through the line" rather than micro-management, empowering full management teams to execute effectively. Hands-on leadership experience in deploying and managing digital automated systems (ERP, TMS, WMS, IoT, Telematics) and applied AI solutions within a supply chain context. Exceptional financial acumen, contract negotiation capabilities, and vendor management skills. Language: Bilingual proficiency in Arabic and English is [mandatory / strongly preferred]. Competencies & Skills: Strategic Planning & Network Design Complex Systems & Operations Integration Operational & Customer Service Excellence Digital Fluency & AI/Analytics Literacy Financial Modeling & Cost-to-Serve Optimization Executive Negotiation & Vendor Management Empowering Leadership & Effective Delegation Change Management & Subsidiary Alignment Cultural Awareness & Cross-functional Collaboration Working Conditions Primarily office-based at the Group HQ, with frequent travel across all regions of Saudi Arabia and to subsidiary operational sites. Requires a valid Saudi driving license. Requires the ability and willingness to conduct on-the-ground visits to warehouses, ports, fleet yards, and key customer locations to audit operations and management teams.

41e0f9f4980824aa.description: About the Role Alesayi Holding is seeking a Fleet Supervisor to manage regional fleet operations in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing the transportation of the workforce between accommodation and client sites, utilizing buses, vans, and service vehicles. The ideal candidate will have 5-10 years of experience in fleet management. Role Overview The Fleet Supervisor is responsible for ensuring reliable and efficient transportation services by managing fleet costs, vehicle utilization, maintenance, safety, and regulatory compliance. The role also includes driver workforce management and monitoring operational performance across the regional fleet. Key Responsibilities Manage the regional fleet budget, including fuel, maintenance, leasing/ownership, drivers, and fines; monitor cost per kilometre and per vehicle, analyze variances, and implement corrective actions. Review and approve supplier invoices and statements of account for fuel, maintenance, leasing, insurance, and spare parts; reconcile charges, investigate discrepancies, and dispute unjustified costs. Develop and review regional route plans, consolidate trips, and optimize fleet size based on operational demand; utilize GPS tracking and fleet data to minimize idle vehicles and unauthorized use. Ensure adherence to preventive maintenance schedules and validate vehicle inspections, registration, insurance, permits, and roadworthiness requirements; monitor vehicle availability and minimize downtime. Enforce driver operating procedures and road-safety standards; investigate incidents, ensure compliance with driving licence requirements, rest hours, and vehicle checks, and follow up on corrective actions. Plan driver staffing levels according to operational demand; manage driver rosters, shifts, attendance, leave coverage, performance, and conduct through Fleet Operations Coordinators. Coordinate transportation requirements for new project mobilization, demobilization, and changes in workforce demand to ensure timely availability of vehicles and drivers. Prepare and review monthly regional fleet performance reports covering trips, kilometres, fuel consumption, vehicle utilization, availability, incidents, and cost per kilometre; identify improvement opportunities. Supervise Fleet Operations Coordinators and drivers, establish performance expectations, address operational issues, and ensure effective coordination across shifts and project locations. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in fleet supervision or a related field. Demonstrated ability to manage regional fleet operations, including budget, maintenance, and compliance. Experience with driver workforce management and operational reporting. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, requiring active management of regional fleet operations and coordination with various teams and project sites. Application Process Candidates interested in this Fleet Supervisor position are encouraged to apply.

413e6b20237827d8.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking an experienced E&I Designer (CS) to join their team. This full-time role focuses on providing construction support for marine and shipbuilding projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering design and technical support to shipyard production teams, resolving design issues, and ensuring compliance with project specifications and marine standards. Role Overview The E&I Designer (Construction Support – CS) will play a critical role in supporting shipyard production by addressing electrical and instrumentation-related design challenges. This involves updating production drawings, verifying design accuracy and constructability, and ensuring adherence to all applicable marine standards. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Provide construction and production support for Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) design activities in marine and shipbuilding projects. Prepare, review, and revise E&I design deliverables. Review shop drawings and production information to identify discrepancies and resolve E&I design-related issues. Offer technical support to shipyard production teams for electrical and instrumentation installation, assembly, and construction activities. Resolve technical queries (TQs), drawing discrepancies, cable routing conflicts, and installation-related design problems. Incorporate engineering changes, production feedback, and redline mark-ups into drawings, cable schedules, and 3D models. Coordinate with Hull Structure, Hull Outfitting, Machinery Outfitting, Piping, HVAC, and other engineering disciplines to ensure proper integration and avoid design clashes. Verify cable routing, equipment locations, installation clearances, and interfaces with marine equipment and structural arrangements. Review vendor drawings, equipment specifications, and technical documentation for compatibility with project design requirements. Ensure E&I design deliverables comply with project specifications, applicable marine standards, classification requirements, and shipyard construction practices. Support constructability reviews and identify potential installation constraints before execution. Maintain updated production drawings, cable schedules, design records, and technical documentation in accordance with project procedures. Coordinate with engineering teams, equipment vendors, and production personnel to ensure timely resolution of design issues. Support as-built drawing updates and incorporate final production modifications, where required. Ensure design deliverables are completed within agreed project schedules and quality requirements. Required Qualifications and Experience Hands-on experience in Construction Support (CS), shipyard production support, and production drawing modifications. Strong experience in electrical and instrumentation layouts, cable routing, equipment installation, and associated production drawings. Proficiency in marine 3D design software, preferably AVEVA Marine / Hull & Outfitting, or other client-accepted shipbuilding CAD software. Experience preparing and modifying 2D production drawings, 3D models, cable routing layouts, termination drawings, and installation details. Good understanding of marine electrical systems, instrumentation installation, cable trays, cable glands, junction boxes, earthing, and bonding arrangements. Ability to interpret electrical and instrumentation drawings, wiring diagrams, cable schedules, equipment specifications, vendor documentation, and production mark-ups. Experience resolving technical queries and supporting shipyard production teams during electrical and instrumentation installation activities. Familiarity with marine electrical standards, applicable IEC requirements, classification society rules, and project specifications. Experience coordinating with Hull Structure, Hull Outfitting, Machinery Outfitting, Piping, HVAC, and other engineering disciplines. Experience in new-build shipbuilding projects, offshore vessels, FPSOs, or similar marine engineering projects is preferred. Exposure to international shipyards, marine EPC contractors, or multidisciplinary engineering environments is preferred. Skills and Attributes Strong technical problem-solving, drawing interpretation, coordination, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a project-driven engineering and shipyard production environment.

4140a04cabac96c3.description: Job Title: Linux & Backup Administrator Department: Information Technology (IT) / Infrastructure Operations Location: Jeddah ______________ Job Summary The Linux & Backup Administrator is responsible for the installation, configuration, maintenance, security, and performance of Linux servers and enterprise backup solutions. الحديد، الإكسسوارات، المواد الكيميائية للإنشاءات، والمعدات الرأسمالية. إدارة التنبؤ بالطلب وتخطيط احتياجات المواد، وتحسين مستويات المخزون. ضمان استمرارية توفير المواد الخام لمرافق الإنتاج والتعاون مع الإدارات المعنية. إدارة عمليات الخدمات اللوجستية الواردة والصادرة، وتحسين تكاليف النقل. قيادة تحسين عمليات سلسلة الإمداد من خلال نظام Oracle وضمان حوكمة البيانات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 5 و10 سنوات في إدارة سلسلة التوريد، ويفضل أن يكون المرشح مهندسًا. خبرة في تصنيع الألمنيوم، تصنيع الزجاج، قطاع الواجهات، والتصنيع المرتبط بالإنشاءات. خبرة قوية في التوريد الاستراتيجي، المشتريات العالمية، إدارة فئات المشتريات، وتطوير الموردين. معرفة قوية بتخطيط الطلب، تخطيط الإنتاج، تحسين المخزون، وإدارة المستودعات والخدمات اللوجستية. خبرة في مشتريات المشاريع وتطوير وتحول سلسلة الإمداد وبرامج خفض التكاليف. معرفة عملية قوية بأنظمة Oracle ERP، Power BI، و Advanced Excel. الكفاءات الأساسية القيادة الاستراتيجية والتفاوض التجاري. الفهم المالي وإدارة علاقات الموردين. إدارة المخاطر وتحليل البيانات. حل المشكلات والقيادة والتعاون بين الإدارات. إدارة أصحاب المصلحة وإدارة التغيير. بيئة العمل يعمل مدير سلسلة التوريد ضمن فريق متخصص في فرع شركة الالمنيوم العربية المتحده في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التزامًا بالعمل بدوام كامل في بيئة ديناميكية تركز على التميز التشغيلي وتحسين الأداء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى شركة رائدة والمساهمة في تحسين عمليات سلسلة الإمداد لديها.

412b69a35f78cb17.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة شيراتون مكة عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة وتوثيق العمليات المالية، بدءاً من إعداد مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات، وصولاً إلى إعداد التقارير المالية الدقيقة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، مما يجعله فرصة مثالية للمحاسبين الطموحين في بداية مسيرتهم المهنية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتحليل المستندات والتقارير المالية. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ المحاسبة وإجراءاتها. الموقع ونوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي لدعم العمليات التشغيلية للشركة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم لهذه الفرصة في شركة شيراتون مكة.

412d7b1ae0e04331.description: About the Role Ultimate Peaks is seeking an IT Specialist to join our team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time position involves the comprehensive execution of daily operations, maintenance, and training related to National Guard simulators, computers, and associated training equipment across various sites and fields. Key Duties The IT Specialist will be responsible for critical operational tasks that ensure the continuous functionality and readiness of all assigned equipment. This includes both routine and responsive technical work. Performing scheduled and unscheduled maintenance on simulator systems and related IT equipment. Setting up and disassembling simulator systems as required for operations and training. Preparing necessary training scenarios to support National Guard operations. Adhering strictly to technical manuals and established safety standards in all tasks. Core Responsibilities Beyond technical duties, the role encompasses administrative and logistical responsibilities vital for effective equipment management and project execution. Managing equipment custody, ensuring proper tracking and accountability. Handling supply operations and maintaining accurate inventory control for all components. Executing project plans as directed, ensuring timely completion of objectives. Preparing comprehensive technical reports detailing maintenance activities, issues, and resolutions. Performing all related administrative tasks necessary for operational support. Work Environment and Travel This role requires flexibility and mobility to support operations across various locations. The specialist will work within a dynamic environment supporting critical infrastructure. Willingness to travel and work across various field sites as required by operational demands. Application Process Candidates interested in this IT Specialist position are encouraged to submit their application for consideration.

The company is expanding its team and seeking individuals who are interested in career development and growth within the organization. The Sales Specialist Role The Sales Specialist is a full-time, on-site position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role is focused on developing new business opportunities, managing client relationships, and promoting the company’s office automation and technology solutions. Opportunities are available across Riyadh, Jeddah, and Al Khobar. Key Responsibilities Meeting with clients to understand their needs Presenting relevant office automation and technology solutions Preparing quotations and proposals for prospective clients Following up on sales leads to progress opportunities Negotiating deals and closing sales Achieving established sales targets Coordinating with internal teams to ensure customer satisfaction Maintaining accurate sales records and client information Identifying opportunities for business growth and expansion Benefits and Work Environment The company offers career growth and development opportunities, along with an attractive salary and benefits package. 4160491f1fd9ef42.job_title: Senior Account Executive - FSI | Saudi Arabia
4160491f1fd9ef42.description: Job description Join a global technology provider specializing in data analytics, AI, business intelligence, and data management solutions. The Senior Account Executive – FSI will drive sales growth and manage strategic enterprise accounts within the financial services sector, focusing primarily on banking and insurance. The role requires an experienced sales professional with a strong background in complex SaaS and technology solutions, particularly in data analytics, AI, and digital transformation. Key Accountabilities: Achieve assigned software revenue targets and business objectives within the banking and insurance sectors. Manage and expand strategic enterprise accounts while identifying and pursuing new business opportunities. Build and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives, business leaders, IT stakeholders, and key decision-makers. Develop and execute strategic sales and account plans aligned with territory dynamics, customer needs, and business growth objectives. Identify customer business challenges and position relevant SaaS, data analytics, AI, and technology solutions to address them. Drive account growth through new customer acquisition, upselling, cross-selling, and expansion of existing client relationships. Map key accounts, understand complex stakeholder ecosystems, and navigate decision-making structures to develop sales opportunities. Generate and qualify leads based on business needs, technical requirements, and commercial potential. Prepare compelling proposals and value propositions that demonstrate business impact and return on investment. Lead and support complex sales cycles, including commercial discussions, pricing, licensing negotiations, and deal closure. Collaborate with internal technical, consulting, marketing, and delivery teams, as well as channel partners and cloud providers, to develop suitable solutions. Maintain a strong understanding of the financial services market, including banking and insurance trends, customer priorities, and competitive dynamics. Identify opportunities related to risk management, regulatory compliance, fraud prevention, customer onboarding, and other financial services applications. Monitor sales pipelines, account performance, market developments, and revenue forecasts to support effective decision-making. Ensure a customer-centric approach by delivering relevant solutions, maintaining customer satisfaction, and building long-term strategic partnerships. Knowledge, Skills, and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Information Technology, or a related field preferred. Extensive experience in enterprise sales, strategic account management, or business development within the technology sector. Proven experience selling complex SaaS solutions and technology services to business and IT stakeholders. Strong understanding of data analytics, artificial intelligence, generative AI, and enterprise technology solutions. Experience working with banks, insurance companies, or other financial services organizations. Knowledge of banking and insurance business challenges, ideally covering risk, compliance, fraud prevention, or customer onboarding. Demonstrated ability to manage strategic enterprise accounts, conduct account mapping, and navigate complex stakeholder environments. Proven track record of achieving sales targets, developing pipelines, negotiating commercial agreements, and closing complex deals. Experience developing strategic sales plans, identifying market opportunities, and driving revenue growth within an assigned territory. Ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value propositions tailored to customer needs. Experience working with channel partners, technology partners, and cloud service providers. Strong commercial acumen, negotiation, presentation, communication, and relationship-building skills. Fluency in both Arabic and English. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a target-driven environment. Willingness to travel within the region as required. Strong analytical thinking, customer focus, initiative, accountability, and problem-solving skills. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

416b73d58056287a.description: About the Role RIHLA EXPRESS is seeking Bike Riders to join their team in Saudi Arabia. 4179c4a23b6084ac.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة عن فني ميكانيكي محركات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في الخرج. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب متابعة دقيقة لتركيب المحركات الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تركيب المحركات الميكانيكية والإشراف على إجراءات تشغيلها. تحديد القطع التبديلية المطلوبة، ومطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية، والعمل على تأمينها. تنفيذ إجراءات استلام المحركات الميكانيكية المخصصة للصيانة والإصلاح. فحص وتشخيص أعطال المحركات بدقة ومتابعة جميع مراحل إصلاحها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ميكانيكا المحركات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على متابعة إجراءات التركيب والتشغيل للمحركات الميكانيكية. مهارات جيدة في تشخيص الأعطال وتحديد الحلول المناسبة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني ميكانيكي المحركات بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، وتحديداً في منطقة الخرج. يتطلب الدور العمل الميداني والمتابعة المستمرة للمحركات الميكانيكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

41a0b77bc59e0244.description: About the Role Manar Al Omran Formwork & Scaffolding Services is seeking a Chief Human Resources Officer to lead the HR function as a strategic growth and governance partner. This full-time role, based in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia, is responsible for the full HR value chain across all Group business lines (manufacturing and trading) and geographical sites within the Kingdom. The position reports directly to the CEO and the Executive Committee, focusing on driving the Group’s growth, compliance, and organizational readiness, particularly in translating growth and IPO-readiness ambitions into an effective organization, workforce, and culture. Key Responsibilities Develop and align the Group HR strategy with business objectives, including organizational priorities, workforce planning, and resource allocation. Manage the annual HR plan, calendar, and budget, ensuring alignment with Finance, Operations, and the Executive Committee. Oversee the HR-side of the Group's ERP transformation program, including data migration, process redesign, and system adoption, ensuring HR data integrity. Lead Group-wide restructuring initiatives to improve organizational agility and cost efficiency, partnering with Finance on headcount cost modeling and workforce cost efficiency programs. Design and maintain the Group's organizational structure, roles, grading, career ladders, and reporting lines, suitable for a multi-entity, IPO-track holding company. Build and maintain succession plans for C-suite and other critical roles, identifying and developing high-potential talent. Own the Group-wide recruitment strategy, including executive search for C-suite and senior leadership roles, and manage recruitment agency relationships. Manage Nitaqat/Saudization compliance and strategy across all Group entities, building structured career development paths for Saudi national talent. Act as the Group's senior representative to the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD), GOSI, and other relevant authorities, ensuring compliance with Saudi labor law. Own Group-wide compensation structure, benchmarking, and benefits strategy, ensuring internal equity and market competitiveness. Provide monthly HR dashboards to the CEO and present quarterly organizational health and workforce risk reviews to the Executive Committee. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in Human Resources. Demonstrated experience in strategic HR leadership within a multi-entity organization. Proven track record in ERP-driven HR transformation, organizational design, and succession planning. Strong understanding of Saudization requirements and government/ministry programs. Experience in managing compensation, benefits, and HR operations. Work Environment This role operates within Manar Al Omran Formwork & Scaffolding Services, a company with business lines in manufacturing and trading across various geographical sites within the Kingdom. The Chief Human Resources Officer will work closely with Finance, Operations, Export, and the CEO's office to ensure HR plans align with capacity, capability, and commercial priorities. Application Process Candidates interested in this Chief Human Resources Officer position are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

41de8bfb6a073a87.description: About the Role Honeywell (KSA) is seeking an Application Engineer I to join its team in Dhahran or Dammam. This full-time position is open to Saudi Nationals only. The role involves working within a project environment, from the study phase through design, implementation, documentation, delivery, and maintenance of Digital Integration solutions, primarily across the Middle East Region. The Application Engineer I will report directly to the Engineering Manager for Digital Integration. Role Context and Focus This position focuses on optimizing project productivity and quality through standardization. The incumbent will support sales activities, including presentations, demonstrations, and participation in Proof of Concept (PoC) initiatives. Digital Integration solutions encompass various skills such as Asset Performance Management (APM), UI/UX, equipment maintenance, and data science techniques. The role requires applying software technologies to deliver APM, Operations Management, and other Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) solutions for the Oil & Gas, Refinery, Chemical, and minerals industries. Solutions may be deployed on-premise or in the Cloud. This is a direct staff position with a billability target of at least 90% to external customer projects, intercompany customer projects, and customer support services. Key Responsibilities Contribute to technical discussions related to asset performance, digital integrations, and data-driven models. Collaborate with lead or senior engineers on project design and delivery. Independently deliver assigned work with minimal supervision. Conduct product demonstrations and proof of concepts. Support the development of conceptual, user requirement, functional, and detailed technical design specifications for digital integration applications. Establish design acceptance with customer stakeholders. Translate and communicate the impact of process and system changes on the bottom line, articulating benefits and value to customers. Ensure appropriate test scripts, test data, test logs, and defect logs are in place for quality delivery. Participate in and facilitate critical project activities, securing customer buy-in and acceptance. Support change management within customer organizations through business process diagrams, training, and best practice documentation. Share technical knowledge with project teams, supervisors, and other disciplines. Communicate technical issues to the internal team, escalating them early in the project lifecycle. Provide pre-sales support to proposal teams. Showcase and define Honeywell’s solutions to potential customers. Work Environment and Travel The position requires approximately 30% travel, primarily within Saudi Arabia and the broader Middle East region. Company Culture and Development Honeywell fosters a culture that promotes inclusion, diversity, and innovation. The company provides market-specific training and ongoing personal development opportunities. Honeywell is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity, ensuring reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in the application, interview, and employment processes.

41f26780d04ccc0b.description: About the Role Saudi Aramco Base Oil Company-Luberef is seeking an Environmental Engineer to join their team in Yanbu Al Sinaiyah, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves monitoring compliance with environmental regulations, company sustainability goals, and various environmental standards across industrial facilities and capital projects. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Role Purpose and Context The Environmental Engineer will be responsible for ensuring adherence to Saudi Arabian, Royal Commission, and Saudi Aramco/Luberef environmental standards. This includes executing environmental impact assessments, monitoring industrial waste and emissions, and coordinating decarbonization and sustainability initiatives to support the company's environmental objectives. Key Responsibilities Audit facility compliance with Saudi Aramco Environmental Standards (SAES), National Centre for Environmental Compliance (NCEC) regulations, and international standards. Conduct regular environmental compliance audits, site inspections, and risk assessments to identify potential environmental hazards. Oversee wastewater treatment, industrial effluent monitoring, and air emission tracking, including flaring, fugitive emissions, and Greenhouse Gas (GHG) reporting. Coordinate the design and implementation of comprehensive Hazardous and Non-Hazardous Solid Waste Management programs in line with circular economy principles. Participate in Environmental Impact Assessments (EIAs) for new projects, facility upgrades, and operational expansions. Collaborate with project engineering teams to integrate Best Available Techniques (BAT) into facility designs. Develop and execute environmental monitoring programs for soil, groundwater, air quality, and noise levels. Prepare routine and dynamic environmental performance reports for senior management and regulatory bodies. Contribute to company-wide net-zero targets by identifying opportunities for energy efficiency, carbon capture/storage, water conservation, and emissions reduction. Lead environmental awareness training and initiatives for site personnel and contractor workforce. Investigate environmental incidents, spills, or non-conformances, and perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA). Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in environmental engineering or a related field. Demonstrated understanding of environmental regulations and standards. Ability to conduct environmental impact assessments and manage waste/emissions. Work Environment This position involves a balance of office-based analytical and reporting work with field inspections across plant processing units, offshore platforms, or remote operational facilities. The work schedule is full-time, with occasional requirements for emergency response or shutdown/turnaround support. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this role to contribute to Saudi Aramco Base Oil Company-Luberef's environmental compliance and sustainability efforts.

Valid SCE (Saudi Council of Engineers) registration. Preferred Previous experience on aviation / airport projects in Saudi Arabia. 417fc27c85563fb5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجموعة اعمال السديات للمقاولات عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ لضمان مطابقة الأعمال للمعايير والمواصفات المعتمدة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المهندس الكهربائي مسؤولية شاملة تشمل دراسة وتصميم وتسعير وتنفيذ ومتابعة مشاريع أنظمة السلامة والحماية من الحريق. كما يضمن مطابقة جميع الأعمال للمخططات والمواصفات والمعايير المعتمدة. تشمل المهام الأساسية ما يلي: إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمختلف المشاريع. إعداد مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية وتحديد مساراتها. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الكهربائية في المشاريع الصناعية. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والمعالجة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الدراسات والتحاليل وعرضها ومناقشتها. مسؤوليات إضافية بالإضافة إلى المهام الرئيسية، يشارك المهندس الكهربائي في مجموعة من الأنشطة التي تضمن سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية: دراسة احتياجات المشاريع وإعداد الحلول الفنية المناسبة. إعداد المخططات التنفيذية وحصر الكميات والتسعير. الإشراف على التنفيذ والاختبارات والتشغيل والتسليم. التنسيق مع العملاء والاستشاريين والمقاولين والجهات المختصة. متابعة أعمال الصيانة والدعم الفني. المشاركة في إعداد العروض والمناقصات والمشاريع الجديدة. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذه الوظيفة، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. فهم عميق لمبادئ التصميم الكهربائي وأنظمة السلامة والحماية من الحريق. القدرة على إعداد المخططات الفنية وحصر الكميات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تنفيذ مشاريع الشركة المتنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

41bd7a61d8ccb2d5.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Safety Supervisor to oversee and implement EHS policies, procedures, and site safety plans. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field, focusing on maintaining a safe and compliant work environment. Key Responsibilities Conduct daily site inspections, safety observations, and workplace risk assessments. Identify hazards and ensure appropriate corrective and preventive actions are taken. Lead Toolbox Talks, safety inductions, and regular HSE training sessions. Monitor compliance with PPE, PTW, LOTO, working at height, lifting, excavation, and confined-space requirements. Ensure proper implementation of Job Safety Analysis (JSA), Risk Assessments, and Method Statements. Investigate accidents, incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions, and prepare detailed reports. Maintain and monitor HSE statistics, KPIs, inspection reports, and safety records. Coordinate emergency preparedness, drills, fire safety, and evacuation procedures. Monitor contractors and subcontractors for compliance with project HSE requirements. Conduct regular site audits and follow up on corrective actions. Ensure proper environmental practices, including waste management, pollution prevention, and spill control. Liaise with project management, clients, consultants, and government authorities on HSE matters. Stop unsafe work when necessary and ensure hazards are rectified before work resumes. Support continuous improvement of the project's HSE culture and performance. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a safety-related role. Experience in Saudi/GCC projects is preferred. Required Skills Strong leadership abilities. Excellent communication and reporting skills. Effective problem-solving capabilities. Ability to work effectively in a site-based and multicultural environment. Work Type This is a full-time position within Larsen & Toubro, focusing on on-site safety supervision. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply.

The role also supports digital transformation and continuous improvement practices. Key Responsibilities Lead process improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and service quality. Analyze operational KPIs, identify performance gaps, and recommend improvement actions. Conduct process mapping, root cause analysis, and process standardization. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve customer experience and service delivery. Support digital transformation, workflow automation, and change management initiatives. Promote continuous improvement practices across operations. Qualifications and Experience 4–6 years of experience in Operational Excellence, Process Improvement, Business Process Management, or Operations. Experience in the insurance or financial services sector. Required Skills Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies is a plus. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, offering an opportunity to contribute to operational excellence within the financial services sector.

414f0287093d0451.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الركن الأول للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس سلامة وصحة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ إجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية في مواقع العمل، وتحديد المخاطر، وضمان توفير واستخدام مستلزمات السلامة. الغرض من الوظيفة يهدف هذا الدور إلى إعداد وتطوير أسس وقواعد وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية في مواقع العمل. يشمل ذلك تحديد الأخطار المهنية ووضع إجراءات لتفاديها، بالإضافة إلى توفير مستلزمات وأدوات السلامة ومتابعة استخدامها. كما يتولى مهندس السلامة إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتطوير أسس وإجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية، مثل سياسة السلامة وتعليمات العمل الآمن والإخلاء ولجان السلامة وسجلات السلامة والفحص الطبي، ومتابعة اعتمادها والالتزام بها. تحديد مكامن الأخطار الميكانيكية والكهربائية والكيميائية في موقع العمل، ووضع الإشارات والملصقات التحذيرية اللازمة. إعداد قوائم ببنود وكميات ومواصفات معدات ومستلزمات السلامة والصحة المهنية، ومتابعة توفيرها وضمان التزام العاملين باستخدامها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال السلامة والصحة المهنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال السلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على إعداد وتطوير الإجراءات والتعليمات الخاصة بالسلامة. مهارات جيدة في تحديد المخاطر ووضع الحلول الوقائية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة الركن الأول للاستشارات الهندسية، مع التركيز على مواقع العمل والمشاريع الهندسية. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المؤهلين والمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في مجال السلامة والصحة المهنية.

41757a57921e01d8.description: About Red Sea Global and Botanica Red Sea Global is seeking a Director of Operations for Botanica, a subsidiary specializing in sustainable greenery for Red Sea Global’s destinations. Botanica integrates new species with local flora, benefiting from shared strategic goals within the Red Sea Global group. The company manages over 1 million square meters, cultivating over 5 million plants since 2020 with a goal of 30 million by 2030, shaping the landscapes of The Red Sea and Amaala. This full-time position is based in Tabuk, specifically in Umluj and Tabuk, and requires over 10 years of experience. Role Purpose The Director of Operations will lead the operational functions of the 180-hectare Botanica site. This includes field operations and plant maintenance, plant protection, irrigation and water management (2,000–4,000 m3 per day from TSE and desalinated sources), soil mix and growing media, logistics, receiving and dispatch, and facilities, fleet, and workshops. The role ensures plant health, timely and complete order fulfillment, and safe and efficient site operations for all business units. This position is critical as failures in irrigation or equipment can lead to significant losses and project delays. Key Responsibilities Manage and organize all nursery areas, including planting zones (1,533,100 m2), shading (173,800 m2), and mother stock areas. Oversee routine maintenance of nursery stock, including weeding, pruning, spacing, cleaning, and daily plant health monitoring. Implement plant protection measures in accordance with the IPM and biosecurity program. Design, operate, and maintain the irrigation network and pump stations, setting irrigation schedules by zone and season. Monitor water quality, flow, and consumption, focusing on reducing freshwater use through TSE, drip, and smart irrigation. Develop and maintain contingency plans for water supply interruptions and system failures. Source raw materials and produce consistent soil mixes and substrates to approved recipes, supplying internal sections and external clients. Manage the receiving of local and imported plants and materials, coordinating with Biosecurity for inspection and quarantine. Plan and execute dispatch operations, including picking, loading, transport, and delivery documentation. Coordinate imports through the bonded facility and maintain accurate stock movement records. Implement preventive and corrective maintenance plans for facilities, greenhouses, shade structures, and equipment. Manage fleet availability, utilization, and compliance, overseeing workshops and the asset register. Manage the Nursery Operations budget, including labor, water, energy, fuel, spares, and maintenance. Allocate manpower, machinery, and transport across sections to support Production and Landscape Maintenance requests. Report KPIs monthly and identify operational risks early with corrective actions. Lead section heads, supervisors, and operatives, setting competency and training standards. Control high-risk activities in collaboration with HSSE, such as machinery, chemicals, lifting, driving, and heat stress. Ensure adherence to all relevant Botanica and RSG Group policies, delegation of authority (DoA), processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions. Champion the safety, quality, and environmental management system (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and the compliance management system (ISO 37301). Identify and lead opportunities for continuous improvement in departmental systems, processes, and practices, focusing on cost reduction, productivity, and client value. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in operations management. Demonstrated ability to manage large-scale operations, particularly in horticulture or similar fields. Experience with sustainable practices and environmental management systems. Strong leadership skills with experience in managing diverse teams. Proficiency in budget management and KPI reporting. Work Environment The Director of Operations will work in a fast-evolving environment, contributing to world-class projects in locations such as Umluj and Tabuk. The role involves working with industry experts and a team committed to ecological harmony, with 40% of the current team from the local community. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to sustainable development and biodiversity preservation at scale. Application Process Candidates interested in this full-time Director Operation position with Red Sea Global are invited to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

41d727407c0011c3.description: About the Role Nahdi Medical Co. is seeking a Family Dentistry Registrar to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Region. This full-time role involves diagnosing and treating injuries or illnesses within the Family Dentistry department. The Registrar will be responsible for patient examinations, medical history documentation, medication prescription, and the ordering, performance, and interpretation of diagnostic tests. The position requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Assess patients and accurately document findings. Design and execute comprehensive patient care plans. Educate patients on their health conditions, necessary investigations, treatment options, and medication usage. Provide patient education on health promotion and disease prevention. Order and review results of patient investigations. Prescribe appropriate medications for patients. Fulfill all obligations related to patient records. Perform other job-related duties and responsibilities as assigned. Adhere to all Nahdi Care Clinics (NCC) Policies and Procedures (P&P), Bylaws Strategic Plan, Rules & Regulation. Adhere to the mission, vision goals, and practice guidelines in NCC. Actively participate in all assigned NCC Committees and Task Forces. Adhere to CBAHI standards of care. Establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships with other departments of the NCC, other local agencies, vendors, patients, their families, and other interested parties. Complete fire safety requirements. Comply with clinical & departmental structure standards, including attendance. Participate in continuous quality improvement / program evaluation activities and observe measures to ensure Clinical, MOH, and CBAHI quality Standards and Regulations are met. Participate in continuous professional development of all junior staff. Integrate population factors of heritage, environment, and disease prevalence into a patient's care. Develop, participate, and support an active Continuing Medical Education program for the Section, Department, or Clinical assigned by the chairman, which may include rounds, conferences, lectures, journal clubs, and other educational activities. Specialty Tasks Perform specific privileges based on training, experience, skills, and in accordance with the guidelines of the Saudi Health Council. Undertake additional tasks based on specialty and clinical privileges. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience. Evidence-based oriented practice. Work Environment This role is based indoors, with 100% of work performed within the clinic environment. The work schedule consists of 6 working days per week, with 1 day off. Daily working hours are 8 net hours, structured according to a shift schedule approved by the head of the department.

41f5431ee99ea085.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رتام الشرق للاتصالات وتقنية المعلومات عن مساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية متابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية، وتنظيم المراسلات والمواعيد اليومية، بالإضافة إلى إنجاز المهام الإدارية المتعلقة بسير العمل وتنسيق الاجتماعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ التعليمات الإدارية الصادرة عن الرئيس المباشر ومتابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية. فتح وفرز البريد الورقي وتوزيعه على المعنيين، والتعامل مع البريد الإلكتروني والرد عليه وفق توجيهات الرئيس المباشر. إنجاز أعمال الطباعة، والرد على الاستفسارات والمكالمات الهاتفية، وتنظيم الملفات الخاصة. حفظ المعاملات والعناية بالملفات بطريقة تسهل عملية الرجوع إليها. تنسيق وتنظيم اجتماعات الرئيس المباشر واجتماعات موظفي الوحدة التنظيمية. المشاركة في الاجتماعات وتدوين وتوثيق محاضرها. طباعة وتوزيع محاضر الاجتماعات الخاصة بالرئيس المباشر على الأطراف المشاركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على متابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية بفعالية. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة لإدارة البريد والمواعيد. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل كتابي وشفوي قوية. القدرة على التعامل مع المهام الإدارية المتعددة. إتقان استخدام برامج الحاسوب المكتبية. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في حفظ الملفات وتوثيق الاجتماعات. نوع الوظيفة وموقع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. يبحث الفريق عن مرشح ملتزم وجاهز للمساهمة في بيئة عمل ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

41fd67f55deb62bb.job_title: Senior Financial Accountant Al Futtaim Automotive BYD
41fd67f55deb62bb.description: About the Role مجموعة الفطيم - غير ذلك is seeking a Senior Financial Accountant to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is central to the company's financial operations, focusing on the accurate and timely recognition, recording, and reporting of revenue in compliance with IFRS 15 and internal policies. The Senior Financial Accountant will manage the revenue close cycle and collaborate with various internal teams. Role Responsibilities The Senior Financial Accountant will be responsible for the following key duties: Applying IFRS 15 to customer contracts, including identifying performance obligations, allocating transaction price, and determining recognition timing. Reviewing new and amended contracts for revenue accounting implications such as variable consideration, discounts, rebates, and multiple-element arrangements. Preparing and posting monthly revenue journals, accruals, deferrals, and unbilled revenue adjustments, and maintaining deferred revenue and contract balance roll-forwards. Owning the revenue and receivables close at month-end, quarter-end, and year-end, including balance sheet reconciliations for all revenue-related accounts. Performing revenue variance analysis versus budget, forecast, and prior periods, and contributing to management reporting and statutory disclosures. Overseeing billing accuracy, monitoring AR ageing and expected credit loss provisions, and operating internal controls over the order-to-cash cycle. Acting as the primary contact for auditors on revenue matters, supporting system and process improvements, and coaching junior accountants. Required Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this position should meet the following criteria: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Professional qualification (CPA, ACCA, CMA, or CA) completed or in progress. 4-6 years of accounting experience, with at least 2 years specifically in revenue accounting. Big 4 audit experience is considered an advantage. Hands-on experience applying IFRS 15 and IFRS 9 in a complex, multi-product or multi-entity environment. Key Attributes Success in this role requires a strong control mindset, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively while consistently meeting deadlines during financial close cycles. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. The salary for this role will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

415180c399298655.description: About the Role Shanahan Engineering is recruiting a Commissioning Manager for a large refinery expansion commissioning project in Al Jubail, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. This is a contract position with an initial duration of 12 months, with potential for extensions, and is expected to start in December 2026. The role requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The primary responsibility of the Commissioning Manager is to ensure that the contractor's scope of services for pre-commissioning and commissioning preparation is executed in compliance with contractual and schedule obligations, and in line with company specifications. The position involves ensuring the safe and smooth execution of all commissioning activities, adhering to the OPERCOM® methodology and utilizing ICAPS© software. The Commissioning Manager, along with a team of discipline specialists, will witness all pre-commissioning and commissioning activities in their assigned area, ensuring full compliance with acceptance criteria and AMIRAL program standards and specifications. Key Responsibilities Ensure safe and compliant pre-commissioning and commissioning activities are carried out by the EPCC contractor with the support of a team of discipline specialists. Organize and ensure the review of contractor documentation within the team. Manage interfaces with other disciplines, contractors, vendors, and the proponent. Monitor and report EPCC contractor progress, identify areas of concern, and adapt priorities according to the critical path and overall project schedule. Support the EPCC contractor with commissioning and handover dossier preparations. Support the review and approval of the contractor's commissioning organization, deliverables, procedures, and planning activities to ensure a safe and efficient operational start-up. Develop pre-commissioning and commissioning activities with the proponent department. Participate in HSE activities. Manage systems and sub-systems definitions. Ensure proper preparation and review of pre-commissioning and commissioning dossiers. Monitor and report on contractor/subcontractor progress. Issue periodic progress reports. Organize and coordinate commissioning execution activities. Qualifications and Requirements Mandatory experience in pre-commissioning and commissioning of petrochemical units and storage facilities. Strong background in instrumentation, electrical systems, and DCS systems (specifically EMERSON). 5-10 years of relevant experience. Contract Details This is a contract position with an initial duration of 12 months, with the possibility of extensions. The starting date for this role is December 2026. Salary details will be discussed during the recruitment process.

416d2a5edf78eace.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking an Executive Sous Chef to join its team in Makkah. This full-time position involves assisting in the direction and administration of all culinary operations within the hotel, focusing on delivering high-quality dining experiences for guests. Key Responsibilities Oversee daily culinary operations, including the preparation and production of hotel meals, ensuring high standards of food quality, presentation, cost controls, and overall profitability. Collaborate with the Executive Chef and Food and Beverage Director to develop and execute menu selections for all Food & Beverage outlets. Engage with guests and clients to gather feedback, identify trends, and support the Executive Chef in implementing improvements to the dining experience. Assist in managing and refining kitchen systems, processes, and workflows to maintain seamless operations. Recruit new talent and foster team growth through regular coaching, training, and recognition opportunities. Maintain compliance with health, safety, and sanitation regulations, ensuring the highest standards of guest and team member well-being. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in culinary operations. The company emphasizes a workplace culture that supports team members in delivering guest experiences. About Hilton Hilton is a global leader in hospitality, recognized for its commitment to providing guest experiences and fostering a supportive workplace. The company has received recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. 418a1f559cead5eb.description: About the Role iPS Powerful People (B Corp™) is seeking a Contracts & Procurement Lead to join their team in Al Jubail, Al Jubayl. This full-time role involves leading the entire contracting and procurement lifecycle, from initial requisition and sourcing strategy through to contract close-out. The successful candidate will be instrumental in developing and executing procurement strategies aligned with project objectives. Key Responsibilities Lead the full contracting and procurement lifecycle, including requisition, sourcing strategy, tendering, evaluation, negotiation, award, contract execution, and close-out. Develop and recommend appropriate contracting strategies, such as lump-sum and unit-rate models. Manage tendering activities, bid meetings, commercial evaluations, negotiations, and contract award processes. Ensure contracts meet all commercial, legal, and technical requirements. Oversee supplier and contractor performance throughout contract execution. Identify root causes of delivery delays, contractual issues, and disputes, and support their resolution. Advise project stakeholders on contract strategy, procurement risk, supplier capability, and market conditions. Develop and execute short- and medium-term procurement and contracting strategies. Establish and monitor procurement and contracting KPIs, including cycle time, cost savings, and supplier performance. Manage procurement budgets, expenditure forecasts, and cost-control activities. Identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining quality, safety, and project standards. Lead supplier qualification, evaluation, performance monitoring, and vendor development activities. Ensure compliance with IKTVA, LCGPA, and local-content requirements. Collaborate with Engineering, Project, Finance, Logistics, and HSEQ teams to align contracting and procurement activities. Manage and supervise the Contracts & Procurement team, assigning responsibilities, setting objectives, and monitoring performance. Coach and develop team members and support capability building within the function. Support the implementation and continuous improvement of procurement policies, procedures, controls, and systems. Lead or support the use of ERP and contract-management platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Ariba, and Procon. Ensure procurement and contracting activities comply with applicable HSE and contractor-safety requirements. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline. Experience: Minimum of 15 years in Contracts and Procurement, with at least 5 years in the Middle East, including Saudi Arabia. Specialized Experience: Strong and demonstrable experience in contracts management, beyond operational purchasing. Extensive experience in: Contracting strategy Tendering and RFQ/RFP processes Bid and commercial evaluation Contract negotiation Contract award Supplier and contractor management Contract administration Contract close-out Contractual risk and dispute management Highly Preferred Experience EPC / EPCM / Capital Project contracting and procurement experience. Experience in large industrial, oil & gas, petrochemical, mining, metals, or heavy-industry projects. Experience managing major EPC or capital-project contracts. Knowledge of Saudi Aramco procurement and contracting standards. Strong understanding of FIDIC, NEC, or similar international contract frameworks. Experience with IKTVA / LCGPA / Saudi Local Content. Hands-on experience with SAP, Oracle, Ariba, and/or Procon. Experience working in multicultural project environments. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Al Jubail, Al Jubayl. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

41cc78f04db0c889.description: About the Role National Initiative Human Resource Company is seeking experienced Crane Operators for a contract position in Al Khobar, Eastern Region. This role is with an esteemed multinational client specializing in mechanical construction, heavy equipment, and crane services. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Review lift plans, risk assessments, lifting procedures, OEM manuals, and load charts before each operation. Operate within rated capacities and manufacturer limits while adhering to company and client safety requirements. Coordinate with riggers and site teams, ensure lifting areas are barricaded, and promptly report equipment defects or safety concerns. Maintain crane housekeeping and participate in toolbox talks and safety training. Experience with Tadano, Liebherr, or Terex AT/RT cranes (80–250 tons) is required; Sany crawler crane experience (800–1,250 tons) is an advantage. Third-party certification, valid or expired, specifying the crane operated. Working knowledge of English and a minimum secondary education. 41cace4d4984edfa.description: About The First Group and Silver Sands Beach The First Group is seeking a Demi Chef de Partie – Pizza for a full-time position in Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This role is based at Silver Sands Beach, a community located on the Red Sea, known for its blend of coastal living and city access. Silver Sands Beach has evolved over six decades into a community focused on cohesion and respect for nature, situated near a natural lagoon suitable for water sports. This position supports the kitchen team in delivering consistent and timely service while maintaining food quality, hygiene, and presentation standards. Ensure consistency in taste, portioning, and presentation of all pizza items. Assist in the daily mise en place and preparation of ingredients required for pizza production. Monitor food quality and ensure all items are prepared and served to the highest standards. Maintain cleanliness and organization of the pizza station, including ovens, work surfaces, and tools. Ensure proper storage and labeling of ingredients in line with food safety standards. Assist in stock control, including monitoring inventory levels and minimizing waste. Follow all hygiene, health, and safety regulations in the kitchen. Support senior chefs and collaborate with team members to ensure smooth kitchen operations. Assist in training commis chefs or junior staff when required. Work Environment This full-time role operates within a dynamic kitchen environment at Silver Sands Beach in Jeddah, focusing on high standards of food preparation and service.

410c1b9a01f86b8b.description: About the Role Compass Project Consulting is seeking a Design Manager to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time, site-based position requires a professional with extensive experience in design management, particularly on major development projects. The role focuses on leading client-side design management functions to ensure project alignment and successful delivery. Key Responsibilities Lead the client-side design management function, ensuring design outputs align with project brief, development strategy, budget, programme, authority requirements, and end-user objectives.
